description: This file defines a Dart class 'ChessGameController' that manages the state of a chess game, including move validation, AI move generation with different difficulty levels, move history management, and game outcome detection. It utilizes the 'chess.dart' package for chess logic and Flutter's ChangeNotifier for state management.

classes.name: MoveRecord
classes.description: A class representing a single move in move history, including move notation, source and destination squares, and whether the move was made by AI.

classes.name: AIDifficulty
classes.description: An enum representing different levels of AI difficulty: easy, medium, and hard.

classes.name: ChessGameController
classes.description: Main controller class for managing the state of a chess game, including move handling, AI logic, game status, and persistence.

methods.name: _toBool
methods.description: Helper to convert various representations to boolean.

methods.name: _pieceToMap
methods.description: Converts a Piece object to a map with 'type' and 'color' keys for UI use.

methods.name: _moveToMap
methods.description: Converts a move object (Map or Move) to a standardized map of relevant properties.

methods.name: setDifficulty
methods.description: Sets AI difficulty level and saves it to shared preferences.

methods.name: _loadDifficulty
methods.description: Loads the saved AI difficulty level from shared preferences.

methods.name: newGame
methods.description: Resets the game to its initial state, clearing move history and redo stack.

methods.name: _findLegalMove
methods.description: Finds a specific legal move from source to destination with optional promotion.

methods.name: makePlayerMove
methods.description: Attempts to perform a player's move if valid.

methods.name: aiMoveNow
methods.description: Triggers the AI to make a move immediately.

methods.name: _chooseBestMove
methods.description: Selects the best move for the AI using negamax search with fixed depth depending on difficulty.

methods.name: _negamax
methods.description: Implements the negamax search algorithm with alpha-beta pruning.

methods.name: _evaluateBoard
methods.description: Evaluates the current board state numerically for AI move selection.
